detail.longDescription: IMPORTANT STATEMENT THAT I SUPPORT The Editorial Board of the journal Partecipazione e Conflitto expresses its strong opposition to, and disbelief at, the news of the dismissal of Professor Michelle Pace from Roskilde # University in # Denmark . [...] The decision to terminate her contract appears to be linked to external pressure and to her political and academic positions on the Palestinian question. # research # palestine # censorship https:// tinyurl.com/2v5dzhk6
